canonicalization.rule: The LSI volume, DSAL/Internet Archive scans, catalogue records, and Wikimedia/PICRYL reproductions are manifestations or derivatives of the same 1906 work/map, not independent corroborating sources.

rights_access.commons_basis_reported: published before 1931; Commons reports free of known copyright restrictions
rights_access.caution: Public-domain copyright status does not remove provenance, historical-classification, cultural-sensitivity, or interpretive-scope requirements.

scope.supported: historical 1906 cartographic representation of the distribution of Munda languages as presented in LSI volume IV

evidence_promotion.reason: The map identity, locator, and public-domain status are verified, but repository-wide deterministic reconciliation and local manifestation/hash/provenance integration are still required before controlled evidence-count mutation.

conversion_requirements: capture a lawful authoritative manifestation and compute repository-local cryptographic hash
verify image against the LSI Vol. IV scan at facing page 7
record map-level locator and, if used, bounded image-region locators
preserve original labels/orthography and distinguish transcription from normalization
qualify every derived statement as historical 1906 survey/cartography
do not infer present-day community, ethnic, political, or land boundaries
complete cultural-access/dignity review before public-facing interpretation
release_effect: Adds a verified, exact-print-locator, public-domain map candidate without fabricating controlled counts or cultural claims.
